note: L5's main roads as approved in the sketch (D-106): the class and the course; the planner routes them over the shaped terrain in L5.

roads.name: Coastal highway
roads.note: Estuary to the cove along the south coast, through the city as a real street. Extended to the cove strip.

roads.name: North road
roads.note: Town, the plain, Finca Morales, up to the jungle camp.

roads.name: East road
roads.note: Now runs through Valle Verde town's main street instead of skirting it, then on to the quarry.

roads.name: Estuary track
roads.note: To the mangrove shack and the sand bar.

roads.name: Sierra road
roads.note: To the hillside villa, extended up to the mesa strip so EGL has a road.

roads.name: City ring
roads.note: New: a ring north of downtown, so a checkpoint on the highway can be driven round (lesson 3).

roads.name: Jungle track
roads.note: New: camp to the La Selva strip (today the strip has no track).

roads.name: Quarry and cove tracks
roads.note: The last few hundred metres to the quarry strip; the cove strip now sits on the highway (R1).
